18import csv
19import tempfile
20import unittest
21from datetime import datetime, timedelta
22from pathlib import Path
23
24from n6705_ui.logging.log_plot_loader import LogPlotLoader
25
26
27class LogPlotLoaderTests(unittest.TestCase):
28 def setUp(self) -> None:
29 self._tmp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
30 self.tmp_path = Path(self._tmp.name)
31
32 def tearDown(self) -> None:
33 self._tmp.cleanup()
34
35 def _write_csv(self, path: Path, rows: list[dict]) -> None:
36 path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
37 with path.open("w", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
38 writer = csv.DictWriter(
39 handle,
40 fieldnames=[
41 "timestamp_iso",
42 "channel",
43 "voltage_v",
44 "current_a",
45 "power_w",
46 "charge_ah",
47 "energy_wh",
48 ],
49 )
50 writer.writeheader()
51 writer.writerows(rows)
52
53 def test_load_single_file_builds_metric_series(self) -> None:
54 csv_path = self.tmp_path / "consumo_a.csv"
55 t0 = datetime(2026, 2, 23, 14, 0, 0)
56 rows = [
57 {
58 "timestamp_iso": (t0 + timedelta(seconds=0)).isoformat(timespec="milliseconds"),
59 "channel": 1,
60 "voltage_v": 5.0,
61 "current_a": 1.0,
62 "power_w": 5.0,
63 "charge_ah": 0.0,
64 "energy_wh": 0.0,
65 },
66 {
67 "timestamp_iso": (t0 + timedelta(seconds=1)).isoformat(timespec="milliseconds"),
68 "channel": 1,
69 "voltage_v": 5.1,
70 "current_a": 1.1,
71 "power_w": 5.61,
72 "charge_ah": 0.0003,
73 "energy_wh": 0.0016,
74 },
75 {
76 "timestamp_iso": (t0 + timedelta(seconds=2)).isoformat(timespec="milliseconds"),
77 "channel": 2,
78 "voltage_v": 12.0,
79 "current_a": 0.2,
80 "power_w": 2.4,
81 "charge_ah": 0.0001,
82 "energy_wh": 0.0007,
83 },
84 ]
85 self._write_csv(csv_path, rows)
86
87 loader = LogPlotLoader(max_points_per_series=300)
88 payload = loader.load_csv_files([csv_path])
89
90 self.assertEqual(payload["file_count"], 1)
91 self.assertEqual(payload["sample_count"], 3)
92 self.assertAlmostEqual(payload["duration_s"], 2.0, places=3)
93 self.assertEqual(len(payload["series"]["voltage_v"]), 2) # CH1 + CH2
94 self.assertEqual(len(payload["series"]["current_a"]), 2)
95
96 first_voltage = payload["series"]["voltage_v"][0]
97 self.assertTrue(first_voltage["name"].startswith("consumo_a.csv | CH"))
98 self.assertGreaterEqual(len(first_voltage["points"]), 1)
99
100 def test_decimation_limits_points_per_series(self) -> None:
101 csv_path = self.tmp_path / "consumo_dense.csv"
102 t0 = datetime(2026, 2, 23, 14, 0, 0)
103 rows = []
104 for idx in range(1600):
105 rows.append(
106 {
107 "timestamp_iso": (t0 + timedelta(milliseconds=idx * 100)).isoformat(timespec="milliseconds"),
108 "channel": 1,
109 "voltage_v": 10.0 + (idx % 10) * 0.01,
110 "current_a": 0.5,
111 "power_w": 5.0,
112 "charge_ah": idx / 1_000_000.0,
113 "energy_wh": idx / 900_000.0,
114 }
115 )
116 self._write_csv(csv_path, rows)
117
118 loader = LogPlotLoader(max_points_per_series=300)
119 payload = loader.load_csv_files([csv_path])
120
121 voltage_series = payload["series"]["voltage_v"][0]
122 self.assertLessEqual(len(voltage_series["points"]), 301)
123
124 def test_missing_columns_raise_clear_error(self) -> None:
125 csv_path = self.tmp_path / "invalid.csv"
126 csv_path.write_text("timestamp_iso,channel\n2026-02-23T14:00:00,1\n", encoding="utf-8")
127
128 loader = LogPlotLoader()
129 with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "faltan columnas"):
130 loader.load_csv_files([csv_path])
131
132
133if __name__ == "__main__":
134 unittest.main()
